# Self Score

> Self Score is an online self-assessment for self-awareness, happiness, inner peace and personal growth. It works like a "credit score for your inner life": you answer reflective questions and get a score with insights and suggestions. Level 1 is free and takes 2–3 minutes; deeper levels are optional.

Self Score is designed as a tool for honest self-inquiry, not a clinical or diagnostic test.

## The levels

- Level 1 (free, 2–3 minutes, 6 questions): how balanced you feel inside right now — happiness, love, peace, freedom, forgiveness and inner harmony.
- Level 2 (5–7 minutes, 9 questions): habits, impulses and inner tendencies that affect your peace and clarity.
- Level 3 (10–15 minutes, 60 questions): your deepest beliefs about life, self, happiness and truth.
- Level 4 (35–40 minutes, 25 open-ended questions, voice answers supported): how consistently you live what you know; reviewed before results are shared.
- Bonus (25–30 minutes): a one-on-one reflective conversation with an AI voice interviewer.

Levels 4 and above require a verified email and a short profile (country, gender, age group).
